what_happened: On job 20261024-002644-1as8 (a prompts job), the user corrected the accepted reading 1. The reading had the verifier instruction go into the shared crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md. The study verifier already uses 1296 of its 1300 tokens with the shared frame, so any addition there fails the budgets test. The user moved the edit to crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md, where the change verifier has about 150 tokens free (1147 of 1300). They capped the addition at about 100 tokens, named the budgets test command that prints each set's size, and said to run the full suite at most once. Both earlier attempts had timed out because of this.
cause: Readings choose where a prompt edit goes without seeing how much token budget each prompt set has left. The shared verifier prompt is composed into several sets, so an addition there costs every set that includes it, and one set had 4 tokens of room. Nothing reports the remaining room per set to the reading or to the producer, and nothing rejects a placement that would exceed it. The producer then retries against the budgets test and slow full suites until its deadline. The user had to supply the location, the size cap and the test method after two timeouts.
prevention: Add a pre-dispatch check for any job whose reading touches prompt files. It computes the token headroom of every prompt set that composes each target file, the same figure the budgets test prints, and adds it to the reading. If the planned addition exceeds the smallest headroom, the reading is refused or the target moves to a file used by fewer sets. The producer's instructions also include the scoped budgets test command and a rule to run the full suite at most once.
proposed_request: Add the new instruction to the change verifier's prompt in crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md only. Do not edit the shared crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md, because the study verifier is at 1296 of its 1300 tokens. The change verifier is at 1147 of 1300, so keep the addition under about 100 tokens. While editing, check sizes with `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture`, which prints each prompt set's size. Run the full test suite at most once, at the end. Done means the budgets test passes for every set and the change verifier prompt contains the instruction.
